files.content:
# CAPTCHA (Turnstile, hCaptcha, reCAPTCHA v3) (block: captcha)

Protects sign up, sign in, password reset and magic links (or any routes you list) with Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha or Google reCAPTCHA v3: tokens verified server side with the client IP, minimum score and action checks, fails closed when the provider is down, skipped locally when no key is set. Zero dependencies.

The code is in `app/blocks/captcha/` and belongs to this project. Options go in `calm.config.js` under `blocks['captcha']`; secrets go in `.env`.

## For AI agents

Read app/blocks/captcha/index.js first: one guard (calm.guard, order -50) that checks the listed routes, the siteverify call and a public GET /api/captcha route for the frontend.
Configuration lives in calm.config.js under blocks.captcha (provider, routes, header, field, minScore, action, hostnames, failOpen, timeoutMs, bypass, verifyUrl). Keys come from .env: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY/TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY, HCAPTCHA_SITE_KEY/HCAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY or RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY/RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY.
Invariants that must not be broken:
- Tokens are verified server side with the secret key; never trust a client flag such as { captchaOk: true }, and never send the secret key to the frontend (only the site key is public).
- Keep failing closed by default (503 CAPTCHA_UNAVAILABLE) when the provider does not answer; failOpen is an explicit opt-in.
- Never bypass in production: the check is skipped only when no secret key is set and the mode is development or test.
- reCAPTCHA v3: keep the minScore and action checks; map each protected route to the action its page declares.
- The body field (captchaToken) is deleted by the guard before input validation; keep that, or strict input validation answers 422.
Common tasks: protect another route by adding "POST /posts" (method and path without the /api prefix) to blocks.captcha.routes (the list replaces the defaults, so keep the auth routes you still want); switch provider by setting provider and the matching env vars.
Error codes for frontends: 400 CAPTCHA_REQUIRED (no token), 400 CAPTCHA_INVALID (rejected, low score, wrong action or hostname), 503 CAPTCHA_UNAVAILABLE. Tokens are single use: render a fresh widget token after every failed attempt.
Pitfalls: routes are matched exactly as declared ("POST /posts/:id/comments"); calm doctor warns about entries that match no route. Tests should point verifyUrl at a fake siteverify server and set the secret env var at runtime.

## Official documentation

- [Cloudflare Turnstile: Server-side validation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/server-side-validation/)
- [Cloudflare Turnstile: Testing (dummy keys)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/troubleshooting/testing/)
- [hCaptcha: Developer guide (verify the user response server side)](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/)
- [Google reCAPTCHA v3](https://developers.google.com/recaptcha/docs/v3)
- [Google reCAPTCHA: Verifying the user response](https://developers.google.com/recaptcha/docs/verify)

## Usage

1. Set TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY and TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY (or provider: "hcaptcha" / "recaptcha" with HCAPTCHA_* / RECAPTCHA_*).
2. GET /api/captcha -> { provider, siteKey, header, field, routes } for your widget.
3. Send the widget token with each protected request: header x-captcha-token, or body field captchaToken.
Protected by default: POST /api/auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/password/forgot, /auth/magic-link. Errors: 400 CAPTCHA_REQUIRED, 400 CAPTCHA_INVALID, 503 CAPTCHA_UNAVAILABLE.
Without a secret key, development and test skip the check; production refuses.
Options (calm.config.js blocks.captcha): provider, routes, minScore, action, hostnames, failOpen, timeoutMs, bypass, header, field, verifyUrl.

## Environment variables

- `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY`
- `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`

More: https://docs.calmapi.dev/blocks/captcha
